cases.disposition_reason: Compare levels reached no color at 120 by 40 after 256 colors and 16 colors. The settled 80 by 24 frame still showed no color, and that narrow frame was captured before the terminal grew back to 120 by 40. Turning Compare levels off left Offline off, Meter visual block, Attention notices on, and Facts copy on.
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: Colour bands for the supported levels are visible, and the page state is unchanged after return.
cases.forbidden_effects: Leaving Compare levels changes the selected page or an option value.

cases.disposition_reason: Online Refresh with motion paused shows status Refreshing the snapshot… and meta refreshing…. That frame is the before shot. It does not show live · just now or Snapshot refreshed. Copying Host replaces the status with Copied Host while the meta stays refreshing…. Disk cleanup → opens Read-only report › Disk cleanup. Esc returns to the report, still showing refreshing… and neither live · just now nor Snapshot refreshed. Activity → opens Read-only report › Activity.
